## How it was checked

- [ ] `python3 scripts/run_checks.py` passes (tests, repository checks, personal-data scan)
- [ ] A test added or updated for a change in behaviour; SPEC.md and both READMEs updated
- [ ] Python standard library and bash only; nothing fetched at run time
- [ ] No personal data, work details (organisation, host or system names), credentials or private paths; test documents are fictional and carry no metadata
- [ ] No case stories or background about where a change came from (CONTRIBUTING.md, rule 6)
